name: Pfadfinder Lagerplatz
beschreibung: The Pfadfinder Lagerplatz is located in Tirol, Österreich, and is operated as a campground. The facility is situated in an alpine environment characterized by mountains and extensive natural areas. Nearby, hiking trails are available, covering various levels of difficulty and making day trips into the surrounding mountain landscape possible. The atmosphere at the site is quiet and close to nature, making it suitable for vacationers with a tent or motorhome. The basic amenities include sanitary facilities and pitches for tents. Guests will find access to ski areas in the surrounding area, which can be used during the winter months. The transport connections allow accessibility by car, although the site is still located away from larger towns.
